text:
Sam Ortega: Partner marketplace team wants a tiny, copyable 'marketplace-iac-kit' they can import. Scope: single terraform module, tiny example app (Node/Express), arm/x86 mapping, optional KMS, smoke CI, and a one-page onboarding. Keep examples <200 LOC.
Priya Nair: Cool. Different from prior FastAPI examples — we'll do Node so partners with JS stacks see an example. Module name = marketplace_shim. Module API minimal: name, image, region, arch (arm|x86), enable_kms (bool).
Liam O'Connor: I'll draft variables.tf and main.tf. Plan to include a local map for instance_type_by_arch and a default var.enable_kms = false. Provide outputs listing_id and kms_key_id (empty string if not created).
Aisha Rahman: Compliance asked for a KMS resource example and an audit-log sink placeholder. Make KMS optional and include COMPLIANCE.md explaining customer KMS vs provider-managed keys.
Sam Ortega: CI should be GitHub Actions smoke.yml: checkout, setup-terraform, terraform fmt -check, tflint, terraform init/plan, terraform apply (auto-approve) in ephemeral test workspace, start the example container with docker run, curl health endpoint, then terraform destroy. Keep tests bash-based.
Priya Nair: Repo layout suggestion: modules/marketplace_shim/{main.tf,variables.tf,outputs.tf}, examples/node-express/{index.js,package.json,Dockerfile}, ci/smoke.yml, docs/{README.md,ONBOARDING.md,COMPLIANCE.md}, LICENSE, .tflint.hcl, terraform.lock.hcl.
Liam O'Connor: Draft HCL snippet (keeping tiny):
```
# modules/marketplace_shim/main.tf
terraform { required_providers { partner = { source = "partnercloud/partner" version = ">= 1.0, < 2.0" } } }
variable "arch" { type = string default = "x86" }
locals { inst = { arm = "c7g.small" x86 = "c6i.small" } }
resource "partner_marketplace_listing" "this" {
  name = var.name
  image = var.image
  instance_type = local.inst[var.arch]
  region = var.region
}
resource "partner_kms_key" "maybe" { count = var.enable_kms ? 1 : 0 purpose = "ENCRYPTION" }
output "listing_id" { value = partner_marketplace_listing.this.id }
output "kms_key_id" { value = length(partner_kms_key.maybe) > 0 ? partner_kms_key.maybe[0].id : "" }
```
Aisha Rahman: Good. For audit sink just include a `resource "partner_log_sink" "audit" { destination = var.audit_sink || "" }` placeholder and explain in COMPLIANCE.md that partners must wire their own logging backends.
Priya Nair: Example Node app outline: index.js with /health and /invoke (returns {model_output: "stub"}). package.json minimal with express. Dockerfile uses node:20-slim. We'll document that secrets must be injected at runtime (env or mounted KMS client).
Liam O'Connor: Add README matrix for supported regions and recommended instance types per arch, plus a short note: "Avoid GPUs requiring host driver install; we recommend managed GPU images only."
Sam Ortega: Add versioning guidance: show required_providers pinning example and module source with semver. Also include a short registry publish note (tag + registry metadata).
Priya Nair: Keep the example HCL <200 LOC and Node app <100 LOC. Include terraform.lock.hcl and .tflint.hcl. CI runs `terraform fmt -check` and `tflint` to fail fast on style.
partner-bot: Partner checklist: https://redwood-internal/partner-checklists/marketplace-iac-kit (auto-post)
Aisha Rahman: ONBOARDING.md should be one page: fork -> pin provider -> run smoke CI -> publish tag -> create PR for Redwood verification. Add a minimal CONTRIBUTING.md for partners.
Liam O'Connor: I'll open the PR tomorrow and tag @Priya and @Aisha. Will include sample vars.tfvars for CI and a short note on testing arm images locally (use cloud runner or qemu with caution).
Sam Ortega: Owners: Liam (PR/module), Priya (examples/docs), Aisha (compliance). Schedule 30m walkthrough after PR if partner wants a live demo.
Priya Nair: One extra: include Apache-2.0 LICENSE and a short snippet showing how to pin provider versions in terraform block.
Liam O'Connor: Roger. I'll keep the PR small and self-contained. Posting link here when ready.
Sam Ortega: Thanks team — focus on small, clear, and copyable. Partner should be able to import this into their CI in under an hour.
